svg.title: Loom — approved identity and terminal banner
svg.desc: Presentation only. The full logo, light icon and dark icon use the unchanged approved glyph paths, stem weights and OO aspect ratio. Icon frames are both 196 by 186 with radius 31; both OO inserts are 136.8 by 103.2 with matching offsets. The TUI banner is the retained 80-column PTY cell visualization, not a native screenshot.

svg.title: Loom wordmark startup banner — retained 80-column PTY frame
svg.desc: PTY cell visualization, not a native terminal screenshot. 12x24 cells, exact quadrant/eighth areas including SGR reverse video. Menlo 20px text; positions and SGR colors from the running executable.
